audience: HR teams and managers who check attendance and work time in TimeHunter

useCases.title: See who is working or on a break now
useCases.text: List every employee with the current work state and the start of today's session. Get one employee's net work time for today.

useCases.title: Review attendance for the team on one day
useCases.text: List check-in, check-out and break times per employee and day. The default is today. Give a date, or a date range.

useCases.title: Check hours and overtime for one employee
useCases.text: Get the work hours, norm, overtime and balance per month. Open the monthly report for the daily work seconds of one employee.

useCases.title: Compare planned shifts with actual presence
useCases.text: List each day's planned start and end for one month, with the actual arrival and departure. Get one employee's report for today to see each work session.
